parallel.title: Checks at once
parallel.description: Each check opens a real connection to the node through the core and measures the answer. The router has one processor and one channel out: more at once measures its own queue, not the node.

interval.title: Check all subscriptions every, minutes
interval.description: How often the router checks every node of every subscription by itself. 0 - only on request.

geo_ttl_s.title: Exit country is fresh for, seconds
geo_ttl_s.description: A measurement of where an output exits is reused for this long; an older one is renewed in the background.

geo_retry_s.title: Retry exit country not more often than, seconds
geo_retry_s.description: An output whose country could not be measured is tried again no sooner than this.
